lines.e1: In the beginning, before anything existed, everything was dark and empty.
lines.e2: There was no sky, no land, no sea... But God was already there.
lines.d1a: Then God said, “Let there be light!” And the light appeared!
lines.d1b: God saw that the light was good. He called the light day, and the darkness night.
lines.d2a: On the second day, God separated the waters and made the sky, high above.
lines.d2b: Up above, the blue sky. Down below, the waters of the sea.
lines.d3a: On the third day, God gathered the waters, and dry land appeared.
lines.d3b: And from the land grew plants, flowers, and trees full of fruit!
lines.d4a: On the fourth day, God put the sun in the sky, to shine during the day...
lines.d4b: ...and the moon and the stars, to light up the night.
lines.d5a: On the fifth day, God filled the waters with fish of every size...
lines.d5b: ...and the sky with little birds that flew and sang.
lines.d6a: On the sixth day, God made the animals of the land: sheep, rabbits, lions, elephants...
lines.d6b: And then God made His most special creation: the man and the woman, Adam and Eve.
lines.d6c: God made them to be like Him, to take loving care of everything He had made.
lines.d7a: God looked at everything He had made, and saw that it was very good!
lines.d7b: On the seventh day, God rested, and made that day a special day.
lines.l1: Everything that exists was made by God, with so much love.
lines.l2: And do you know who else He made with all His care?
lines.l4: Now talk with your family: which part of creation do you like best?
lines.fim: Subscribe to the channel! Next story: Adam and Eve in the Garden of Eden.
